title: Evaluating the Impact of Community Oversight for Managing Mobile Privacy and Security
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the impact of a mobile app on mobile privacy and security management through community oversight. While privacy and security have ethical dimensions, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study. It briefly mentions 'spiritual' apps as a category that users might uninstall, but this is not a central theme.
